title: Virtual-knot problem 20 — Embeddings of Surfaces
statement:
Embeddings of Surfaces: Given a non-trivial virtual knot $K$.
Prove that there exists a minimal realization of $K$ in
$N=S_{g}\times I$ and an unknotted embedding of
$N\subset\mathbb{R}^{3}$ such that the obtained classical knot in
$\mathbb{R}^{3}$ is not trivial. (This problem is partially solved
by Dye in .
